summary.text: Mark Harris represents Idaho Senate District 35, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists Soda Springs as Harris's city and Assistant Majority Leader as a leadership post.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Harris holds a B.A. in political science from Utah State University and is a rancher.
It also lists service as a board member of Bear Lake Memorial Hospital and as a former state board member of the Idaho Farm Bureau and the Idaho Cattle Association.
